current_evidence: Grokbot's 'cdc-20-07-26' checklist (and its sibling removal/variation 'cdc-20-07-26' checklist) now return a client error while other cotswold.gov.uk media PDFs fetch normally; the supporting-information page does not expose its checklist links, and the newest official full-planning checklist I could find and open is the Publica 'full-planning-permission-validation-checklist-26-09-25' PDF (date only in the filename, no date in the text), so I could not confirm whether a July 2026 version is still the live one.

issues.detail: The List date 2026-07-01 comes from the PDF's CreationDate metadata, not from text in the document. The filename suggests 20 July 2026 instead, and the Publica full checklist that does open has no date anywhere in its text. The date is unsupported.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'Date basis': 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; the 26-09-25 checklist states no adoption, publication or version date
issues.grok_comment: The date basis is indeed PDF metadata. But the linked document does carry a date in its text, the header "Rev 1 - 20 July 2026", so the list date should be 2026-07-20 (taken from the document text), not undated.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The document header says "Rev 1 - 20 July 2026", so the month is right; only the date basis is wrong.

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but Cotswold publishes a Householder validation checklist with local requirements: Archaeological Assessment (new building or ground disturbance on or next to an archaeological heritage asset); Biodiversity Survey and Report (works affecting an existing roof, for bats, or works close to a pond or watercourse); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (possible loss of light or overshadowing of neighbours); Flood Risk Assessment/Drainage Strategy (minor extensions in Flood Zone 2/3, following EA standing advice); Tree Survey/Arboricultural Assessment (near a tree or hedge with a stem over 75mm at 1.5m); Heritage Statement (listed property); Design and Access Statement (more than 100 sqm of new floorspace); CIL Form 1/2 (new residential floorspace).
issues.evidence: householder-validation-checklist.pdf: 'Householder guide to preparing and submitting a planning application', Cotswold DC, July 2019, amended 25.02.2020

issues.detail: Full planning has only 11 rows, against about 49 items in the full planning checklist. Missing items include: Design and Access Statement (major; LBC; WHS/conservation area with 1+ dwelling or 100 sqm+); Affordable Housing Statement (Cotswold: 11+ dwellings or over 1,000 sqm, or 6-10 rural dwellings); Agricultural/Forestry Dwelling Justification (new rural worker dwelling); Air Quality Assessment (in or next to an AQMA, or air quality impacts); Biodiversity Self-Assessment (all new applications unless a Biodiversity Report is submitted); Biodiversity Report; Coal Mining Assessment (groundworks in coal mining areas); CIL Form 1 (any new floorspace; liable at 100 sqm+ GIA); Flood Risk Assessment (FZ2/3, all major, critical drainage areas); Foul Sewerage Assessment FDA1 (non-mains drainage); Land Contamination Assessment; LVIA; Landscaping Scheme (new commercial/residential); Lighting Assessment; Mains Sewage Capacity Assessment (all major, Cotswold); Noise Impact Assessment; Open Space Assessment (loss of open space); Planning Obligation/Heads of Terms; Site Waste Management Plan (major, employment 300 sqm+, retail 500 sqm+); Statement of Community Involvement (major); Structural Survey (Cotswold: conversion of countryside barns/buildings); Surface Water Drainage Strategy (major, FZ2/3); Sustainability Statement (Cotswold: all applications in Stow-on-the-Wold and The Swells); Town Centre Uses Evidence; Transport Statement/Assessment; Tree Survey/AIA (trees or hedges with stems over 75mm); Ventilation/Extraction Statement (restaurants, takeaways, hot food); Waste Minimisation Statement (all major).

Most Full planning triggers are fragments or blended with neighbouring rows, and do not say when the item is needed. Examples: Retail Impact Assessment reads 'Desirable for a variation of an existing legal agreement' (that is the S106 row; the actual Cotswold trigger is a retail increase of 100 sqm+ outside a centre or leisure over 500 sqm); Heritage Statement 'to the Heritage Statement requirement.'; Planning Statement 'countryside Supporting Planning Statement'; Pre-application 'of the pre-application advice process.'; Archaeology quotes the CIfA standards line instead of 'site may contain or affect archaeological deposits'; Floor plans/Elevations uses the 1:5/1:1 joinery detail text instead of 'extends floorspace / alterations / new building'; Fire Statement is fused with Design and Access Statement text and omits the 18m / 7-storey threshold; LBC/s73 'Existing and proposed site levels' is fused with the CIL charging text; CIL row ends '...Biodiversity Net Gain'; Self-build 'CIL e.g. self-build.'
issues.evidence: Source triggers, e.g. Retail Impact Assessment: 'Cotswold: retail increase of 100 sqm+ outside a centre, or leisure over 500 sqm gross'; Fire Statement: 'Buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with more than one dwelling'

issues.detail: Every Listed building consent row (BNG, site plan, CIL, site levels, elevations, planning statement, pre-app, roof plan, self-build) comes from the 'Removal or variation of a condition' checklist. Grokbot copied the s73 requirements into LBC; in fact LBC is covered by the full planning permission and LBC checklist. CIL and BNG do not apply to listed building consent.
issues.evidence: LBC rows' source = .../xfoey3fh/removal-or-variation-of-a-condition-validation-checklist-cdc-20-07-26-af.pdf; the 26-09-25 full checklist covers 'Full Planning Permission and Listed Building Consent'

issues.detail: Fire Statement is filed under 'Change of use - prior approval' because the excerpt mentions 'material change in use'. It comes from the full planning checklist, applies to full applications for relevant buildings (18m+ or 7+ storeys), and that excerpt is the exemption wording. Prior approval is not covered by that checklist.
issues.evidence: Full checklist item 4: 'Fire Statement - Buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with more than one dwelling; exempt for some material changes of use'

issues.detail: Outline, Advertisement consent, Demolition in conservation area and Permission in principle all show '(none)'. The full checklist says it covers full planning with demolition in a conservation area and with display of advertisements, and its Biodiversity Self-Assessment applies to Full, Outline, LBC and PiP. The supporting-information page also describes separate demolition-in-conservation-area and prior notification checklists. Discharge of conditions shows '(none)' even though Grokbot read the discharge checklist.
issues.evidence: Full checklist: 'Biodiversity Self-Assessment - All new applications, unless a Biodiversity Report is submitted (Full, Outline, LBC, Permission in Principle)'; planning page: 'This validation checklist sets out the information you must submit...' (demolition in a conservation area)

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process or boilerplate text, not requirements: 'Once the application has been registered, any further supporting information must be emailed to us.'; 'We will only use your personal information gathered for the specific purposes of your application/enquiry.'; the public register / 30mb upload text; 'Document type Application Form Correct Application Fee ... What information is required?' (a table header); 'Units must be hectares for habitats...'; 'Further information about reliefs and exemptions is available here...'.

'All drawings should be supplied in a scalable format, ideally as PDF documents and not in draft format.' appears in about 11 tab_items, each joined to an unrelated fragment ('A schedule/layout of homes...', 'Please see our website to download the Biodiversity Self-Assessment...'). 'All drawings must include a title, drawing number, confirmation of the scale and a scale bar' appears 3 times.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' rows 4-14; 'Drawing / document standards' rows 3, 5, 6

issues.detail: Grokbot read the superseded 2022 checklists (removal/variation 25-11-2022, NMA 7-11-2022, discharge 7-11-2022) alongside the 2026 versions of the same checklists, and took tab_items from the 2022 removal/variation and discharge PDFs. Requirements from the current and superseded versions are mixed together.

The workbook records the list as 'council-specific'. The current full checklist that opens is a joint Publica document for Cotswold, West Oxfordshire and Forest of Dean, with council-specific thresholds inside it (e.g. affordable housing, retail, sustainability).
issues.evidence: 26-09-25 checklist: 'a shared checklist for the Cotswold, West Oxfordshire, and Forest of Dean councils'

issues.detail: Biodiversity Net Gain and Ecological Survey are listed under Non-material amendment. Statutory BNG does not apply to s96A non-material amendments, and the excerpt is generic BNG metric text. I could not open the NMA source to confirm, so this needs checking.
issues.evidence: NMA trigger excerpt: 'If the Statutory Biodiversity Metric has been used to evidence a measurable net gain...'

summary: Grokbot's July 2026 Cotswold checklist link (and its sibling) now fail, and the date comes from PDF metadata. The extraction captures only a fraction of the full planning checklist's ~49 items, wrongly says Householder has no local requirements, copies s73 items into LBC, and is full of garbled triggers, boilerplate and duplicates.
